words.definition: n. 栅栏，篱笆；vi. 击剑；闪烁其词

examples.en: The whole estate is enclosed by a fence to keep the deer out.
examples.zh: 整片庄园围有栅栏，以防鹿群进入。

examples.en: The minister fenced with reporters over questions about the tax bill.
examples.zh: 部长在记者追问税改法案时闪烁其词。

words.usage: 习语 sit on the fence（骑墙观望）考研高频；动词 fence with sb（回避正面回答）。派生：fencing n. 击剑运动；短语 fence off（用栅栏隔开）

confusables.note: 因此；h 与 f 形近

collocations: sit on the fence 骑墙观望
fence off the garden 用栅栏隔开花园
a picket fence 尖桩篱笆
words.mnemonic: fence 谐「分死」：栅栏把两家分得死死的 → 篱笆

words.definition: n. 平民，老百姓；adj. 平民的，民用的

examples.en: The airstrike killed scores of civilians and wounded dozens more.
examples.zh: 空袭造成数十名平民死亡，另有数十人受伤。

examples.en: After twenty years in uniform, he found civilian life oddly quiet.
examples.zh: 从军二十年后，他觉得平民生活出奇地安静。

words.usage: civilian 与军人、警察相对，citizen 则指拥有国籍者，注意区分。常见搭配 civilian casualties（平民伤亡）。派生：civil adj. 公民的，民事的
collocations: civilian casualties 平民伤亡
civilian life 平民生活
civilian government 文官政府
words.mnemonic: civil（民）+ian（人）→ 民间之人 → 平民，与军人相对

words.definition: vt. 放纵，迁就；使沉溺；vi. 尽情享受，沉溺

examples.en: Retirement gave him time to indulge his passion for local history.
examples.zh: 退休让他有时间尽情投入对地方史的热爱。

examples.en: He indulged in a brief fantasy of quitting on the spot.
examples.zh: 他短暂地沉浸于当场辞职的幻想之中。

words.usage: indulge in sth（沉溺于）；indulge sb with sth（纵容某人）。派生：indulgence n. 放纵；indulgent adj. 纵容的；indulgently adv.
collocations: indulge in fantasy 沉溺于幻想
indulge a hobby 投入爱好
an indulgent parent 纵容的父母
words.mnemonic: in（进）+dulge → 一头扎进欲望里 → 沉溺、放纵

words.definition: n. 忠诚，效忠；（对政党等的）拥护

examples.en: New officials must swear allegiance to the constitution before taking office.
examples.zh: 新官员就职前必须宣誓效忠宪法。

examples.en: Rising costs are pushing lifelong voters to shift their allegiance to smaller parties.
examples.zh: 生活成本上升正促使终身支持者把票投给小党。

words.usage: 常与 to 连用：allegiance to sb 或 sth；swear 或 pledge allegiance（宣誓效忠）高频；比 loyalty 更正式，政治色彩浓。派生：allegiant adj. 忠诚的

confusables.note: 断言；同根 leg 易混

collocations: swear allegiance 宣誓效忠
allegiance to the crown 效忠王室
pledge allegiance 宣誓效忠
words.mnemonic: al（向）+leg（法律）+iance → 以法为誓 → 效忠

words.definition: prep. 在…旁边；与…一起；adv. 并排地

examples.en: The new digital platform will operate alongside the existing branch network.
examples.zh: 新的数字平台将与现有网点并行运营。

examples.en: A police car drew up alongside the van and signalled it to stop.
examples.zh: 一辆警车开到货车旁边，示意它停下。

words.usage: 介词用法最常考：alongside sb 或 sth（与…并肩、一同）；副词用于 pull alongside（并排停下）；对比 along（沿长边）
collocations: work alongside... 与…共事
pull alongside... 并排停靠
alongside local businesses 与本地企业一道
words.mnemonic: along（沿）+side（边）→ 沿着边 → 在…旁边

words.definition: n. 高原；平台期，停滞期；vi. 趋于平稳

examples.en: House prices have hit a plateau after two years of steep growth.
examples.zh: 经过两年快速上涨，房价进入了平台期。

examples.en: Sales plateaued once the initial buzz around the gadget faded.
examples.zh: 这款电子产品的炒作热度消退后，销量趋于平稳。

words.usage: reach 或 hit a plateau（进入平台期）高频；动词 plateau 表「趋平」随之常考；复数 plateaus 或 plateaux。派生：plateaued adj. 停滞的
collocations: reach a plateau 进入平台期
the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau 青藏高原
a plateau in growth 增长平台期
words.mnemonic: plate（平的盘子）+au → 平坦的高地；曲线变平 → 平台期

words.definition: n. 塑料（常复数）；adj. 塑料的；可塑的

examples.en: The EU has moved to outlaw single-use plastics across member states.
examples.zh: 欧盟已着手在各成员国禁用一次性塑料制品。

examples.en: The infant brain is remarkably plastic, rewiring itself with every experience.
examples.zh: 婴幼儿大脑可塑性极强，会随每次经历重新布线。

words.usage: 复数 plastics 指塑料材料；plastic surgery（整形手术）高频；神经科学语境取「可塑的」本义。派生：plasticity n. 可塑性

confusables.note: 有弹性的；e 开头易混

collocations: single-use plastics 一次性塑料
plastic surgery 整形手术
plastic waste 塑料垃圾
words.mnemonic: plast（塑形）+ic → 能随意塑形的 → 塑料；可塑的

words.definition: n. 电路，线路；巡回，环形道

examples.en: A short circuit in the aging wiring sparked the basement fire.
examples.zh: 老化线路短路引发了地下室火灾。

examples.en: The veteran star is competing on the international circuit this season.
examples.zh: 这位老将本赛季转战国际巡回赛。

words.usage: be on the circuit（巡回中）；circuit breaker（断路器，金融指熔断机制）；同根 circulate。派生：circuitous adj. 迂回的；circuitry n. 电路系统
collocations: short circuit 短路
printed circuit board 印制电路板
circuit court 巡回法院
words.mnemonic: circ（圆环，同 circle）+uit → 绕一圈的线 → 电路

words.definition: n. 避难，庇护；避难处

examples.en: Journalists sought refuge in the embassy during the coup.
examples.zh: 政变期间，记者们到大使馆避难。

examples.en: The abandoned mine offered refuge from the sudden storm.
examples.zh: 废弃矿井成了躲避暴风雨的藏身处。

words.usage: take 或 seek refuge（避难）高频搭配；refuge from sth（躲避…）；人用 refugee，处所用 refuge，勿混。同根 fug（逃）见 fugitive
collocations: take refuge 躲避，避难
seek refuge 寻求庇护
a refuge from the storm 躲避风暴之处
words.mnemonic: re（回）+fug（逃）+e → 逃回去的地方 → 避难所

words.definition: n. 代表，代表团成员；vt. 委派；授权，下放

examples.en: Effective managers delegate routine tasks and focus on strategy.
examples.zh: 高效的管理者把例行任务委派出去，专注于战略。

examples.en: Each province sent delegates to the constitutional convention.
examples.zh: 各省派代表出席了制宪会议。

words.usage: delegate sth to sb（把…委派给某人）；常与 authority、tasks 搭配。派生：delegation n. 代表团；委托。相关：relegate v. 降级
collocations: delegate authority 下放权力
delegate tasks 委派任务
conference delegates 与会代表
words.mnemonic: de（离开）+leg（派送）+ate → 派出去的人 → 代表

words.definition: adj. 雄辩的，有说服力的；生动传神的

examples.en: Her eloquent plea for the refugees swayed several undecided delegates.
examples.zh: 她为难民所作的雄辩恳求打动了几位犹豫不决的代表。

examples.en: The ruined temple stands as an eloquent testament to the city's former glory.
examples.zh: 这座残破的神庙雄辩地见证了这座城市昔日的辉煌。

words.usage: be eloquent about 或 on sth（对…侃侃而谈）；an eloquent testament to（生动证明）阅读高频。派生：eloquence n. 雄辩
collocations: an eloquent speaker 能言善辩的演讲者
eloquent testimony 有说服力的证词
be eloquent on sth 对…侃侃而谈
words.mnemonic: e（出）+loqu（说）+ent → 说得头头是道 → 雄辩的

words.definition: n. 洗发水，香波；vt. 用洗发剂洗（头发）

examples.en: The stylist will shampoo and condition your hair before the cut.
examples.zh: 发型师会先为你洗发护发，然后再修剪。

examples.en: This mild shampoo is formulated for sensitive scalps.
examples.zh: 这款温和洗发水专为敏感头皮调配。

words.usage: 名词可数（a shampoo 一瓶或一次洗头）或不可数；动词 shampoo one's hair。源自印地语，音译「香波」；复数 shampoos。相关词 conditioner n. 护发素
collocations: herbal shampoo 草本洗发水
shampoo and conditioner 洗发水与护发素
shampoo one's hair 洗头
words.mnemonic: 音译「香波」：闻着香的洗头水 → 洗发水

words.definition: vt. 磨碎，碾碎；vi. 摩擦作响；n. 苦差事

examples.en: The mill grinds wheat into flour for the entire village.
examples.zh: 这座磨坊为全村把小麦磨成面粉。

examples.en: The daily grind of commuting slowly wore the workers down.
examples.zh: 日复一日的通勤苦差慢慢磨垮了这些工人。

words.usage: grind to a halt（慢慢停下）、the daily grind（日常苦差）为阅读高频；grind down（折磨，压迫）。过去式 ground 与名词「地面」同形。派生：grinder n. 研磨机

confusables.note: 宏大；i 与 a 一字差

collocations: grind coffee beans 磨咖啡豆
the daily grind 日常苦差事
grind to a halt 逐渐停顿
words.mnemonic: 碾得咯吱响 → 磨碎；日日像被磨 → 苦差事

words.definition: n. 品脱（液量单位）；一品脱的量（如啤酒）

examples.en: He ordered a pint of bitter and found a corner table.
examples.zh: 他点了一品脱苦啤酒，找了个角落坐下。

examples.en: Whisk half a pint of cream until it thickens.
examples.zh: 把半品脱奶油搅打至浓稠。

words.usage: 英制液量单位，英制约 0.57 升，美制约 0.47 升；a pint of beer 透着英式酒吧文化。复数 pints。注意与 paint（油漆）元音不同

confusables.note: 点；po 与 pi 之差

collocations: a pint of milk 一品脱牛奶
half a pint 半品脱
a pint of beer 一品脱啤酒
words.mnemonic: pint 谐「派恩特」：量酒的派头单位 → 品脱

words.definition: vt. 使粉碎，使（希望）破灭；vi. 碎裂

examples.en: The unexpected defeat shattered the team's confidence.
examples.zh: 这场意外的失利击碎了全队的信心。

examples.en: The window shattered when the blast wave swept through the street.
examples.zh: 冲击波扫过街道时，窗玻璃轰然碎裂。

words.usage: shatter one's confidence 或 hopes（使信心、希望破灭）高频；shatter 表碎成多片，比 break 猛烈。派生：shattered adj. 粉碎的；心力交瘁的

confusables.note: 撒开；sc 与 sh 易混

collocations: shatter sb's confidence 击碎某人信心
shatter into pieces 摔成碎片
shattered dreams 破灭的梦想
words.mnemonic: 哗啦一声碎一地 → 使粉碎；与 scatter（撒开）一字差

words.definition: n. 大头针，别针；vt. 别住，钉住；把…归咎于

examples.en: Investigators were accused of trying to pin the blame on a junior engineer.
examples.zh: 调查方被指企图把责任推给一名初级工程师。

examples.en: She pinned the badge to her lapel before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前她把徽章别在翻领上。

words.usage: pin sth on sb（把罪责推给某人）阅读常考；pin down（确定，查明）重要短语。派生：pinpoint v. 精确定位；adj. 极小的

confusables.note: 钢笔；元音 e 与 i 异

collocations: pin the blame on... 把责任推给…
pin down 确定，查明
a safety pin 安全别针
words.mnemonic: pen（笔）换了元音：笔尖如针 → 别针

words.definition: vt. 流出（泪、血）；脱落；摆脱；n. 棚，小屋

examples.en: Snakes shed their skins several times a year as they grow.
examples.zh: 蛇在生长过程中每年蜕皮数次。

examples.en: The struggling airline shed four hundred jobs last quarter.
examples.zh: 这家困境中的航空公司上季度裁掉了四百个岗位。

words.usage: shed light on（阐明）为考研超高频；shed tears 或 jobs 或 weight 均可搭；过去式 shed 不变。名词指工具棚。派生：watershed n. 分水岭，转折点
collocations: shed light on 阐明
shed tears 流泪
shed jobs 裁减岗位
words.mnemonic: 谐「谢的」：花谢叶落 → 脱落；引申流泪、摆脱

words.definition: vt. 举起，抬高；提升（地位）；使（情绪）高涨

examples.en: Regular moderate exercise elevates mood and improves sleep quality.
examples.zh: 规律适度运动能提升情绪、改善睡眠质量。

examples.en: The reform elevated millions of rural workers into the urban middle class.
examples.zh: 改革使数百万农村劳动者跻身城市中产。

words.usage: 较 raise、lift 正式，常用于地位、情绪、血压（elevated levels）。派生：elevator n. 电梯；elevation n. 海拔，高度；elevated adj. 升高的

confusables.note: 减轻；同根 lev 勿混

collocations: elevate sb's mood 使某人情绪高涨
elevated blood pressure 血压升高
elevate sb to... 把某人提拔到…
words.mnemonic: e（出）+lev（举）+ate → 举起来 → 提升；电梯同根

words.definition: vt. 剪（羊毛等）；剥夺；n. 剪切（力）

examples.en: Farmers shear the sheep in early spring before the lambing season.
examples.zh: 农民在早春产羔季之前剪羊毛。

examples.en: The panel was sheared off the wing in the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴中这块面板从机翼上被撕脱。

words.usage: be shorn of（被剥夺）书面高频；过去分词 shorn；名词复数 shears（大剪刀）。同音词 sheer（纯粹的、陡峭的）最易混淆，务必区分
collocations: shear sheep 剪羊毛
be shorn of... 被剥夺…
shear force 剪切力
words.mnemonic: she（她）在 ear（耳朵）旁咔嚓一剪 → 剪

words.definition: vi. 咧嘴笑，露齿笑；n. 咧嘴的笑

examples.en: He grinned broadly as the judges read out his name.
examples.zh: 评委念出他的名字时，他咧嘴大笑。

examples.en: She gave a wry grin and admitted the miscalculation.
examples.zh: 她苦笑了一下，承认自己算错了。

words.usage: grin and bear it（逆来顺受）、grin from ear to ear（笑得合不拢嘴）高频习语；grin 露齿，smile 不露齿。派生：grinning adj. 咧嘴笑的
collocations: grin and bear it 逆来顺受
grin from ear to ear 笑得合不拢嘴
a wry grin 苦笑
words.mnemonic: gr（咧）+in → 嘴咧开牙全露 → 咧嘴笑
